name: Gucci Pop-up Store — Shinsegae Gangnam
tagline: The current collection, plus pieces sold only here
description: Gucci takes over the first-floor event space at Shinsegae's Gangnam store with a curated run of the current collection — women's and men's ready-to-wear, handbags including the Jackie and Paparazzi lines, shoes and accessories. A handful of items are sold only at this pop-up for the length of the run. You can book a slot through Gucci's own site, or simply walk in.
